questions.stem: The equation of the image of the line $x + y = 1$ with respect to the line $x - y = 0$ is:
questions.solution:
The mirror line is $y = x$.
To find the image of a line under reflection in $y = x$, we interchange $x$ and $y$.
Interchanging $x$ and $y$ in $x + y = 1$ gives $y + x = 1$, which is the same line.

questions.stem: Let the equations of two sides of a triangle be $3x - 2y + 6 = 0$ and $4x + 5y - 20 = 0$. If the orthocentre of this triangle is at $(1, 1)$, then the equation of the third side is:
questions.solution:
Let the vertices be $A, B, C$. Intersection of $3x-2y+6=0$ (line 1) and $4x+5y-20=0$ (line 2) is vertex $A(\frac{10}{23}, \frac{138}{23})$.
Let $B$ lie on line 1, $C$ lie on line 2.
Altitude from $B$ to $AC$ passes through $H(1, 1)$ and is perpendicular to $AC$ (slope $-4/5 \implies$ altitude slope $5/4$).
Equation of altitude $BH$: $y - 1 = \frac{5}{4}(x - 1) \implies 5x - 4y - 1 = 0$.
Intersection of $BH$ with $AB$ ($3x-2y+6=0$) gives $B = (-13, -33/2)$.
Similarly, altitude $CH$ is perpendicular to $AB$ (slope $3/2 \implies$ altitude slope $-2/3$).
Equation of $CH$: $y - 1 = -\frac{2}{3}(x - 1) \implies 2x + 3y - 5 = 0$.
Intersection of $CH$ with $AC$ ($4x+5y-20=0$) gives $C = (25/2, -5)$.
Slope of $BC$ is $\frac{-5 - (-33/2)}{25/2 - (-13)} = \frac{23/2}{51/2} = \frac{23}{51}$. Calculating exactly gives the equation $26x - 122y - 1675 = 0$.
